name: PandaDoc
description: PandaDoc lets agents list documents and templates, check document status, and create documents from templates. Each user signs in to their own PandaDoc account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my documents are waiting for a signature?
Create a draft proposal for Acme Corp from my standard template.

apps.name: PandaDoc
apps.description: Document and template access and document creation, over PandaDoc's MCP server with browser sign-in.
